# Provenance of the .msg fixtures

Copied unchanged from python-oxmsg (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 Steve Canny),
`tests/test_files/` at commit `d0ee4645d4a8bf6d18517d33bc1f7dcb23e7620b` of
https://github.com/scanny/python-oxmsg.

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `message.msg` | HTML body, To recipient, one attachment |
| `no-attachments.msg` | plain-text body, no attachments |
| `not-a-MSG-file.msg` | a PNG named .msg: must be reported as damaged |
